title: 第19章 攻城第20章 原地建房
slug: 从哥布林开始骑马砍杀
content_zh:
艰难屯的三个领导班子还在城墙上站着，商量要不要出兵救少爷，可李秦武已经主动带着哥布林军队涌了上来。
“敌人来了！”
了望塔上的士兵看见森林里走出一群哥布林，惊慌发出预警。
三人立马停止争执，向森林边缘看去，然后就倒吸一口凉气。
哥布林从森林中涌出，站在森林和农田交界处，虽然只有200多只哥布林，可只都手持木矛战列成了方阵，而且这其中还有穿着奇怪皮革的大哥布林，居然有20只！
要知道哥布林是混沌种，他们虽然是社会型魔物，但组织度非常薄弱，能像人类这样能列成方阵，简直是不可思议！
哈娜小姐满脸震惊的看着这一幕，随即更让她更震惊的事发生了。
“少爷！！”
只见哥布林方阵中竖起一根高高的柱子，柱子上挂着她心心念念的兰斯少爷！
兰斯少爷此时还处于眩晕状态，身上被扒了个干净，被绑在柱子最顶部，和面人型战旗一样。
哈娜小姐顿时红眼，拔出腰间的长剑对士兵呼喊道：“士兵们！救出你们的领主！和我一起上！”
她一句话喊完，众人争相应和的场景没有发生，城墙上所有人都看傻逼一样看着她。
大姐，你要不要听听你在说什么？对面有200多人，我们只有70多人，虽然对面大都是小孩子似的哥布林，可他们这边的着甲士兵也只有7个，剩下的都是群拿农具的老农。
讲白了，他们属于南山敬老院VS北海幼儿园，谁也不比谁牛逼。
现在他们占着城墙的优势，立于不败之地，放弃城墙，主动下去和对方干仗，那不是脑残吗？
雷奥骑士咳嗽一声。
“哈娜小姐冷静一点，放弃城墙不是明智之举，我们先静观其变。”
哈娜小姐顿时跳脚，她指着变成旗帜的兰斯少爷。
“雷奥骑士！魔法森林已经让你的骑士精神蒙沉了吗？我从来没见哪个王国骑士会在领主受辱时不动于衷！”
面对哈娜小姐的指责，雷奥骑士只是淡淡的说了句：“嗯，上个月我的战马适应不了森林气候得瘟疫死了，我已经不是骑士了。”

哈娜小姐气的脑淤血，她正想继续和对方纠缠，蒙德管家打断了他们。
“别吵了，快看对面的哥布林！”
李秦武把刚捉住的贵族少爷当战旗竖了起来，希望能羞辱城堡里的守军，让他们出来救人，结果对面无动于衷，一个个站在城墙上看戏。
他百分百确认了，这个逼根本不是什么重要角色，都竖起来了，城堡守军还无动于衷，这个逼怕只是个有点小钱，买了件好看衣裳的花花公子哦。
李秦武挠了挠头，没办法了，尝试佯攻一下，看看对面城堡里有多少人。
不过进攻之前，得把刚缴获的装备分配一下。
刚刚从贵族少爷和护卫身上获得的武器为：

content_en:
The three leaders of Hardship Village were still standing on the city wall, discussing whether to send troops to rescue the young master, but Li Qinwu had already taken the initiative to rush up with the goblin army.
"The enemy is coming!"
The soldiers on the watchtower saw a group of goblins coming out of the forest and issued a warning in panic.
The three of them immediately stopped arguing, looked towards the edge of the forest, and then took a deep breath.
Goblins poured out of the forest and stood at the junction of the forest and farmland. Although there were only more than 200 goblins, they were all armed with wooden spears and formed a square formation. Among them were big goblins wearing strange leathers. There were actually 20 of them!
You must know that Goblins are a species of chaos. Although they are social monsters, their organization is very weak. It is incredible that they can form a square formation like humans!
Miss Hana looked at this scene with a shocked face, and then something even more shocking happened to her.
"Master!!"
She saw a tall pillar erected in the Goblin phalanx, and on the pillar hung Master Lance, whom she had longed for!
Master Lance was still in a dazed state at this time. His body was stripped clean and tied to the top of the pillar, just like a human-shaped battle flag.
Miss Hana's eyes suddenly turned red. She pulled out the sword from her waist and shouted to the soldiers: "Soldiers! Rescue your lord! Come with me!"
After she finished her sentence, the scene of everyone rushing to respond did not happen. Everyone on the city wall looked at her like an idiot.
Sister, do you want to listen to what you are saying? There were more than 200 people on the opposite side, and we only had more than 70 people. Although most of the people on the opposite side were goblins who looked like children, there were only 7 armored soldiers on their side, and the rest were old farmers holding farm tools.
To put it bluntly, they belong to Nanshan Nursing Home VS Beihai Kindergarten, and no one is better than the other.
Now that they have the advantage of the city wall and are in an invincible position, wouldn't it be crazy to abandon the city wall and take the initiative to fight with the opponent?
Leo Knight coughed.
"Miss Hana, calm down. It's not a wise move to abandon the city wall. Let's wait and see what happens."
Miss Hana jumped up and pointed at Master Lance who had turned into a flag.
"Knight Leo! Has the magic forest dulled your spirit of chivalry? I have never seen any knight from the kingdom remain indifferent when the lord is humiliated!"
Faced with Miss Hana's accusation, Knight Leo just said lightly: "Well, last month my horse couldn't adapt to the forest climate and died of the plague. I am no longer a knight."
Miss Hana was so angry that her brain was bruised. She was about to continue entangled with the other party when Butler Mond interrupted them.
"Stop arguing and look at the Goblin on the other side!"
Li Qinwu erected the newly captured aristocratic young man as a battle flag, hoping to humiliate the defenders in the castle and get them to come out to rescue people. However, the other party remained indifferent and stood on the wall to watch the show.
He was 100% sure that this guy was not an important character at all. Even though he was standing up, the castle defenders were still indifferent. This guy was probably just a playboy who had a little money and bought some nice clothes.
Li Qinwu scratched his head. He had no choice but to try a feint to see how many people were in the castle opposite.
However, before attacking, the newly captured equipment must be distributed.
The weapons just obtained from the noble young master and the bodyguard are:
